svg.title: Lab lifecycle and independent control
svg.desc: Lifecycle state machine. Successful build and resume arm a 24-hour lease. Private Hybrid Runbook Workers remain available during suspension. Destruction removes all customer-controlled lab resources and discloses mandatory Azure retention. Native editable vector shapes and text. Official Azure icons are embedded vector artwork from the Microsoft Azure icon library. Design source: docs/specification.md and DECISIONS-ACCEPTED.md.

g.text: Single-command build, suspend, resume, and destroy / persisted desired state / private management path
Control invariant: shared lifecycle lock + step journal + exact ownership manifest. Failed postconditions return nonzero.
Successful readiness arms a new 24h deadline.
Traffic, tests, and idempotent reruns preserve the existing deadline. The operator session can disconnect.
Save the approved runtime baseline first
Disable schedules; cancel chaos; resolve in-flight writes.
Deactivate revisions; stop jobs and restart triggers.
Stop PostgreSQL preserving HA and data.
Reduce Dedicated nodes only where supported.
Verify each resource state; inventory retained services.
Private access and HA configuration remain intact.
Retained during suspension / deleted during destroy
Private control store + required network path
Deadline, lock, desired state, and step journal
Keep required NAT, DNS, and endpoint paths alive.
Load the saved state; recover interrupted transitions.
Check routes, DNS, identities, registry, and endpoints.
Wait for primary and healthy standby.
Restore capacity, image digest, revisions, and traffic.
Verify retained data, baseline, and public-access denial.
Arm the new lease only after readiness passes.
PostgreSQL can automatically start after seven stopped days. The private controller stops it again; application runtime stays suspended.
Available from any state; disable scheduling and reconcile actual effects first
Explicit lab ID / subscription / manifest / deletion plan
Export evidence only if explicitly requested.
Remove owned resources, roles, and directory objects.
Purge Key Vault; keep cleanup network and permissions.
3 / External operator or CI completes teardown
Delete workers, Automation, storage, VNets, NAT, and groups.
Verify cleanup; remove scoped temporary local state.
Disclose mandatory Azure remnants: Activity Log 90 days; deleted PostgreSQL backups 5 days. Source and input configuration remain.
